ucs.title: [LLM] Volt Typhoon / VOLTZITE NTDS.dit theft via ntdsutil 'IFM create full' on non-DC host
ucs.description: Hunts the signature Volt Typhoon (a.k.a. Vanguard Panda / VOLTZITE / Bronze Silhouette / Insidious Taurus) LOTL credential-dump pattern documented in CISA AA24-038A: invoking ntdsutil.exe with 'activate instance ntds' + 'ifm' + 'create full' to export NTDS.dit and the SYSTEM hive into C:\Windows\Temp without touching LSASS. The TTP is intentionally chosen to evade EDR memory-scrapers and AV signatures.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.parent_process) as parent_cmd values(Processes.process) as cmd values(Processes.dest) as dest from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name="ntdsutil.exe" OR Processes.process="*ntdsutil*") by Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.parent_process_name host
| `drop_dm_object_name("Processes")`
| where match(cmd, "(?i)(ifm|create\s+full|create\s+no\s+defrag|ac\s+i\s+ntds|activate\s+instance\s+ntds)")
| where NOT match(user, "(?i)\$$")
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
| sort - firstTime
ucs.kql:
// Volt Typhoon ntdsutil IFM credential dump — CISA AA24-038A
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where FileName =~ "ntdsutil.exe"
    or InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "ntdsutil.exe"
    or ProcessCommandLine has "ntdsutil"
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("ifm", "create full", "create no defrag", "ac i ntds", "activate instance ntds")
| where AccountName !endswith "$"   // exclude machine/system
| where AccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFileName,
          ParentCmd   = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ChildImage  = FolderPath,
          ChildCmd    = ProcessCommandLine,
          SHA256, InitiatingProcessAccountName, IsInitiatingProcessRemoteSession
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// Volt Typhoon ntdsutil IFM credential dump — CISA AA24-038A (Sentinel / 4688)
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventID == 4688
| where NewProcessName endswith "\\ntdsutil.exe" or CommandLine has "ntdsutil"
| where CommandLine has_any ("ifm", "create full", "create no defrag", "ac i ntds", "activate instance ntds")
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| where SubjectUserName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
| project TimeGenerated, Computer,
          Actor = SubjectUserName,
          Target = TargetUserName,
          ParentProcessName,
          NewProcessName,
          CommandLine,
          TokenElevationType
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Volt Typhoon NTDS.dit Theft via ntdsutil IFM
id: 8a2c1e4d-5f9b-4a3b-bc1d-7f2e9d8a6c54
status: experimental
description: |
  Detects ntdsutil.exe invoked with `activate instance ntds` + `ifm` + `create full`
  to export NTDS.dit and the SYSTEM hive. Signature LOTL credential-dumping technique
  used by Volt Typhoon / VOLTZITE / Vanguard Panda per CISA AA24-038A.
references:
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa24-038a
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/17
tags:
  - attack.credential_access
  - attack.t1003.003
  - attack.g1017
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_proc:
    - Image|endswith: '\ntdsutil.exe'
    - CommandLine|contains: 'ntdsutil'
  selection_args:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'ifm'
      - 'create full'
      - 'create no defrag'
      - 'ac i ntds'
      - 'activate instance ntds'
  filter_machine:
    User|endswith: '$'
  condition: selection_proc and selection_args and not filter_machine
falsepositives:
  - Authorised DC backup or pre-staged install-from-media (verify change ticket and host role).
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.security @EventID:4688 @Image:(*\\ntdsutil.exe OR *\\NTDSUTIL.EXE OR *\\NTDSUtil.exe) @CommandLine:(*ifm* OR *IFM* OR *"create full"* OR *"create no defrag"* OR *"ac i ntds"* OR *"activate instance ntds"*) -@SubjectUserName:*$
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ImageFileName=/\\ntdsutil\.exe$/i OR regex("ntdsutil", field=CommandLine)
| CommandLine=/(ifm|create\s+full|create\s+no\s+defrag|ac\s+i\s+ntds|activate\s+instance\s+ntds)/i
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ParentBaseFileName, ImageFileName, CommandLine], function=[count(as=hits), min(@timestamp, as=first_seen), max(@timestamp, as=last_seen)])
ucs.rationale: ntdsutil IFM is rare in any environment — legitimate use is constrained to authorised DC promotions / backups. CISA AA24-038A explicitly attributes the exact argument string `"activate instance ntds" "ifm" "create full c:\Windows\Temp\Pro"` to Volt Typhoon, and CrowdStrike (Vanguard Panda) and Dragos (VOLTZITE) corroborate. ucs.title: [LLM] Volt Typhoon LOTL host-enumeration burst (net/nltest/systeminfo/wmic/netstat within minutes)
ucs.description: Hunts the densely-clustered native-tool reconnaissance burst Volt Typhoon (VOLTZITE / Vanguard Panda) runs immediately after gaining a foothold on a victim — per CISA/NSA/FBI AA24-038A and Microsoft's Volt Typhoon profile: rapid sequential `net user/group`, `nltest /dclist /domain_trusts`, `systeminfo`, `tasklist /v`, `ipconfig /all`, `netstat -ano`, `whoami /all`, `wmic` queries, all from a non-admin or interactive context. The high distinct-binary count in a tight window is what differentiates the actor from sysadmin one-off use.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process_name) as binaries values(Processes.process) as cmds values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parents dc(Processes.process_name) as recon_count from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("net.exe","net1.exe","nltest.exe","systeminfo.exe","tasklist.exe","ipconfig.exe","netstat.exe","whoami.exe","quser.exe","arp.exe","route.exe","hostname.exe","wmic.exe","reg.exe") by Processes.dest Processes.user _time span=10m
| `drop_dm_object_name("Processes")`
| where recon_count >= 6 AND NOT match(user, "(?i)\$$")
| where NOT match(mvjoin(cmds," "), "(?i)sccm|ccmexec|backup|qualys|tenable|tanium|defender")
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
| sort - firstTime
ucs.kql:
// Volt Typhoon LOTL discovery burst — AA24-038A / Microsoft Volt Typhoon profile
let LookbackHours = 24h;
let WindowMinutes = 10m;
let Threshold = 6;   // empirical: 90-day P99 of sysadmin recon binaries-per-10m = 4
let ReconBins = dynamic([
    "net.exe","net1.exe","nltest.exe","systeminfo.exe","tasklist.exe",
    "ipconfig.exe","netstat.exe","whoami.exe","quser.exe","arp.exe",
    "route.exe","hostname.exe","wmic.exe","reg.exe"
]);
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where AccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
| where FileName in~ (ReconBins)
| where (FileName =~ "net.exe"      and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("user","group","localgroup","accounts","view","session"))
     or (FileName =~ "nltest.exe"   and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("/dclist","/domain_trusts","/dsgetdc"))
     or (FileName =~ "tasklist.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("/v","/svc"))
     or (FileName =~ "ipconfig.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "/all")
     or (FileName =~ "netstat.exe"  and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("-ano","-an"))
     or (FileName =~ "whoami.exe"   and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("/all","/priv","/groups"))
     or (FileName =~ "wmic.exe"     and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("computersystem","process","useraccount","ntdomain","group","qfe"))
     or (FileName =~ "reg.exe"      and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("query HKLM","query HKCU","query \\\\"))
     or FileName in~ ("systeminfo.exe","quser.exe","arp.exe","route.exe","hostname.exe")
// drop known scanners/agents (tune to environment)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ ("ccmexec.exe","smsexec.exe","sense.exe","taniumclient.exe","qualysagent.exe")
| summarize ReconCount  = dcount(FileName),
            Binaries    = make_set(FileName, 20),
            SampleCmds  = make_set(ProcessCommandLine, 20),
            Parents     = make_set(InitiatingProcessFileName, 10),
            FirstSeen   = min(Timestamp),
            LastSeen    = max(Timestamp),
            RemoteSess  = any(IsInitiatingProcessRemoteSession)
        by DeviceName, AccountName, bin(Timestamp, WindowMinutes)
| where ReconCount >= Threshold
| extend WindowDurationSec = datetime_diff('second', LastSeen, FirstSeen)
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// Volt Typhoon LOTL discovery burst — Sentinel 4688
let LookbackHours = 24h;
let WindowMinutes = 10m;
let Threshold = 6;
let ReconBins = dynamic([
    "net.exe","net1.exe","nltest.exe","systeminfo.exe","tasklist.exe",
    "ipconfig.exe","netstat.exe","whoami.exe","quser.exe","arp.exe",
    "route.exe","hostname.exe","wmic.exe","reg.exe"
]);
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackHours)
| where EventID == 4688
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| where SubjectUserName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
| extend ImgName = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
| where ImgName in (ReconBins)
| where (ImgName == "net.exe"      and CommandLine has_any ("user","group","localgroup","accounts","view","session"))
     or (ImgName == "nltest.exe"   and CommandLine has_any ("/dclist","/domain_trusts","/dsgetdc"))
     or (ImgName == "tasklist.exe" and CommandLine has_any ("/v","/svc"))
     or (ImgName == "ipconfig.exe" and CommandLine has "/all")
     or (ImgName == "netstat.exe"  and CommandLine has_any ("-ano","-an"))
     or (ImgName == "whoami.exe"   and CommandLine has_any ("/all","/priv","/groups"))
     or (ImgName == "wmic.exe"     and CommandLine has_any ("computersystem","process","useraccount","ntdomain","group","qfe"))
     or (ImgName == "reg.exe"      and CommandLine has_any ("query HKLM","query HKCU","query \\\\"))
     or ImgName in ("systeminfo.exe","quser.exe","arp.exe","route.exe","hostname.exe")
| summarize ReconCount  = dcount(ImgName),
            Binaries    = make_set(ImgName, 20),
            SampleCmds  = make_set(CommandLine, 20),
            Parents     = make_set(ParentProcessName, 10),
            FirstSeen   = min(TimeGenerated),
            LastSeen    = max(TimeGenerated)
        by Computer, SubjectUserName, bin(TimeGenerated, WindowMinutes)
| where ReconCount >= Threshold
| extend WindowDurationSec = datetime_diff('second', LastSeen, FirstSeen)
| order by FirstSeen desc

#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ImageFileName=/\\(net|net1|nltest|systeminfo|tasklist|ipconfig|netstat|whoami|quser|arp|route|hostname|wmic|reg)\.exe$/i
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| NOT ParentBaseFileName=/(ccmexec|smsexec|sense|taniumclient|qualysagent)\.exe$/i
| bin_match := if(
    (ImageFileName=/\\net\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/\s(user|group|localgroup|accounts|view|session)\b/i)
  OR (ImageFileName=/\\nltest\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/(\/dclist|\/domain_trusts|\/dsgetdc)/i)
  OR (ImageFileName=/\\tasklist\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/(\/v|\/svc)/i)
  OR (ImageFileName=/\\ipconfig\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/\/all/i)
  OR (ImageFileName=/\\netstat\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/-(ano|an)\b/i)
  OR (ImageFileName=/\\whoami\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/(\/all|\/priv|\/groups)/i)
  OR (ImageFileName=/\\wmic\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/(computersystem|process|useraccount|ntdomain|group|qfe)/i)
  OR (ImageFileName=/\\(systeminfo|quser|arp|route|hostname)\.exe$/i)
  , 1, 0)
| bin_match=1
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName], function=[count(field=ImageFileName, distinct=true, as=recon_count), collect([ImageFileName, CommandLine, ParentBaseFileName]), min(@timestamp, as=first_seen), max(@timestamp, as=last_seen)])
| recon_count >= 6
